description:
What is This Part?
This is a Locking Fuel Cap that comes with 2 keys
Has a built-in Twist/Torque Limiter to prevent over tightening that could restrict air flow into the tank.
Comes with 2 keys
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Locking Gas Cap
Qty 2 – Keys
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Sidekick 1989 – 1998 All Models
Geo Tracker 1989 – 1998 All Models
